name: Martial Perfection

source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

summary: During either player's Fight phase, you can use this to select one friendly Emperor’s Children unit that has not been selected to fight this phase, then re-roll Hit rolls for the selected unit until the end of the phase. Use once per phase.
